caseNameFull: Massey-Harris-Ferguson Limited v. Boyd, U. S. District Judge

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit and the alternative motion for leave to file a petition for writ of mandamus or other appropriate writ denied.
